claims.statement: For the order-91 T_22 control, attaching one new pendant leaf at the root yields an eligible order-92 tree for which the original marked leaf has a negative selected summand at every eligible rank and the complete favorable-leaf sum is strictly negative at every eligible rank.
claims.scope: Exact finite computation for T_22 with one new leaf attached at root 0; p=35,...,45, with x=33, alpha=68, and strict 3p<2alpha+1. No other padding length, attachment vertex, or source tree is covered.
claims.reason: Pinned exact forest-DP coefficient counts and direct evaluations of every leaf selector and selected summand cover all eligible integer ranks for this fixed padded tree. The result is a bounded obstruction for this instance, not a general theorem or a resolution of the registered aggregate.

limitations: Only the supplied T_22 positive-fibre control and a single root-adjacent pendant leaf were evaluated; no uniform obstruction for pendant-path padding was proved.
The exact finite result does not prove or refute the universal ordinary favorable-leaf aggregate.
